VR Control Center — bundled Windows tools

The complete, unmodified scrcpy Windows x64 distribution is included under
resources/tools/win32-x64/scrcpy. The Android server matches the scrcpy client.
No binaries from PATH are required for the default automatic Windows setup.

scrcpy 5.0.1 — Genymobile and contributors, Apache License 2.0.
Official archive:
https://github.com/Genymobile/scrcpy/releases/download/v5.0.1/scrcpy-win64-v5.0.1.zip
SHA-256: b12a2c4ee8be317422451fc7dcf8ee20a71b5ea7ef9ad73ddd825a25316227a5
Source and dependency build recipes:
https://github.com/Genymobile/scrcpy/tree/v5.0.1/app/deps
https://github.com/Genymobile/scrcpy/archive/refs/tags/v5.0.1.tar.gz
License: SCRCPY-APACHE-2.0.txt (also retained in the original tools directory).

ADB 37.0.1 and AdbWinApi.dll / AdbWinUsbApi.dll are identical to Google's official
platform-tools_r37.0.1-win.zip. The complete upstream notices are in ADB-NOTICE.txt.
https://dl.google.com/android/repository/platform-tools_r37.0.1-win.zip
Archive SHA-256: 45f4d63113e895ebde0c90f194099a4676b6ac653bd28d54314a9e022bbc1a99
Source: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/packages/modules/adb/

FFmpeg 9.0.2 — FFmpeg contributors, LGPL 2.1 or later; license: LGPL-2.1.txt.
Source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz
Source SHA-256: 8c3850283eb25fa026482078a04051e0be17347b09ef81a0849bec15a96e002e
The exact configuration is in scrcpy v5.0.1 app/deps/ffmpeg.sh and in the DLL's
embedded build configuration. The shipped libraries use dynamic linking.

LICENSES.chromium.html in the installed/unpacked application directory.
